analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 trading days maintained a wait-and-see stance. RSI declined from 67.0 to 55.3, cooling from overbought territory, and MACD histogram improvement weakened from 2.5335 to -0.0227. A Higher Low pattern began forming as the 5-day low ($322.73) exceeded the 20-day low ($303.80) by more than 1.005. Volume ratio surged to 2.71, increasing the reliability of the movement. Weekly ADX at 27.6 indicates a persistent clear trend. The current price ($345.88) is above the SMA20 ($340.44) but below the SMA5 ($360.43). Approaching the swing support level ($342.11). The overall market sentiment shifted to 60% positive vs. 40% negative. However, due to the lack of a clear directional signal on the daily chart, a wait-and-see approach is maintained.
